verdict.rationale: Foreloop lets a non-engineer start from a plain-language problem with no knowledge of which files change. After a person approves the contract, an agent claims the task, does the work, opens a pull request, and the PR gets an automated product review. However, the agent has to be run by someone in a repository checkout on their own machine, and the only visual inputs are marked-up screenshots from the feedback widget, not design mockups. Missing for 10: ingesting a mockup or design file as the spec, removing the need for someone to set up and run the agent in a local checkout, and independent or hands-on evidence that PM-driven requests ship without engineering involvement.
